company_name: Madhya Pradesh State Electronics Development Corporation (MPSEDC)
semiconductor_relevance: Low — MPSEDC is primarily focused on ecosystem development and skill enhancement rather than direct semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Madhya Pradesh State Electronics Development Corporation (MPSEDC) is a government entity dedicated to fostering the electronics and semiconductor ecosystem in Madhya Pradesh, India. Its initiatives are centered around skill development and supporting the growth of semiconductor-related activities in the region.

regional_presence.India: MPSEDC operates within Madhya Pradesh, focusing on regional development in the electronics and semiconductor sectors.
